api_and_semantics.paths: Nonnull absolute paths, no filesystem inspection, existence, regular-file or alias restrictions. Regular files and FIFOs accepted.
api_and_semantics.ownership: Caller owns endpoints and FIFO peer connection; redirected opens may block until peers connect. Owner never deletes endpoints.
api_and_semantics.redirection: Actual ProcessBuilder input/output/error redirects open before trusted gate startup/release. stdout and stderr are separate and output truncation can occur even if preparation later fails. Gate inherits streams through exec.
api_and_semantics.supervisor: Supervisor stdin remains the controller liveness pipe. Only endpoint paths are serialized via standard.input, standard.output, standard.error. All absent means legacy; partial, empty or relative properties throw IOException before inner tree acquisition.
api_and_semantics.compatibility: Existing nine-component Launch and legacy prepare behavior preserved. Both modes share lifecycle implementation; null is private legacy sentinel only. Explicit null files rejected before acquisition.
api_and_semantics.preserved: Outer cgroup identity, containment before release, process result, reaping, cleanup and ownership-failure lifecycle remain unchanged.

red.observed: Child exit 7; stdout incorrectly contained stderr bytes and separate error retained stale 700-byte data. Assertion: StandardFiles.redirect must keep stderr separate and truncate its destination

standalone_green.scope: Actual production redirect, XML serialization/parser, validation and null-before-acquisition. Binary 256-byte stdin, separate stderr, truncation, exit 7. Does not prove native public prepare/cgroup integration.
